name: Evidence Board
description: A detective corkboard: speckled cork, polaroids with sketched clues, typed index cards, yellow sticky notes, red push pins and red string, with a case-file label taped at the top and a rubber stamp for the verdict. The camera moves across the board clue by clue as red string draws itself from pin to pin.
style: Nafay, Illustrated — detective corkboard, polaroids, red string, verdict stamp
